morning: A new day, a new tabula rasa.
Clarity is just a few prompts away.
The day hasn't ruined you yet, {name}
afternoon: The day is half gone, let's make the second half count.
evening: The distractions are winding down. The thinking can begin.
Aristotle did his best work at dusk. Now it's your turn.
The sun sets, {name}. The mind rises.
late: The best philosophers were night owls too.
Seek the light in the dark.
The world's quiet, best time to talk.

starterFallback: Why do we fear death if we won't be there to experience it?
Was Socrates right to accept his own death?
starterQuestions: Why do we fear death if we won't be there to experience it?
Was Socrates right to accept his own death?
Can you ever truly know yourself?
Is meaning something you find or something you create?
Does power always corrupt, or does it just reveal character?
Could a machine ever be truly conscious?
Is comfort the enemy of growth?
Do you fear being wrong more than being ignorant?

steps.title: Socratic
steps.detail: Your all in one space for deep, open-ended conversation. Bring any topic, idea, or question and we'll make sure you think harder than you were planning to.

steps.title: Debate
steps.detail: Pick a topic, pick a side, and go head to head with an AI that argues back for real. Learn and improve instantly using the Post Match Report.

steps.title: Roleplay
steps.detail: Have an actual conversation with a philosopher, in their own voice and logic. Discuss ideas, life and more...

steps.title: Switch modes
steps.detail: Switch modes from the top dropdown or the sidebar shortcuts for Socratic, Debate, and Talk to a Philosopher.

debate.chooseToneCopy: Choose how Socratic AI should sound while challenging your argument.
debate.timingInfo: Short formats are faster and sharper. Longer formats go deeper and become more layered.
debate.chooseClockCopy: Duration changes both the timer and the style of the debate.
debate.topicCopy: Enter your own philosophy thesis or generate one.
debate.topicPlaceholder: Example: Moral progress is mostly a myth societies tell themselves.
debate.sideCopy: Pick whether you defend the thesis or attack it.
debate.affirmBody: You defend the claim. Socratic AI attacks it.
debate.rejectBody: You attack the claim. Socratic AI defends it.
debate.readyCopy:
Timed debates end permanently when the clock runs out.
After the debate ends, you'll be able to view your debate summary and feedback.
debate.suggestedTopicsCopy: Pick one thesis to drop into the debate setup.
debate.enterTopicError: Enter a philosophy topic or generate one.
debate.invalidTopicFallback: That topic does not fit debate mode yet. Reframe it philosophically.
debate.endedCopy: The clock has run out. Review the Post-Match Report or reveal the verdict here.
debate.winnerFallback: The verdict is available in the Post-Match Report.

roleplay.title: Some conversations change how you think forever.
roleplay.copy: Every philosopher here spent their life building a way of seeing. This is your chance to borrow it, not through textbooks, but through real back-and-forth conversation.
roleplay.emptyCopy: Try a school, a name, or a problem like power, anxiety, freedom, or morality.
